answer: Attention Ledger Quota. Each identity must answer unpredictable, task-relevant micro-queries within a random window; the system samples response latency and semantic consistency, requiring sustained human-grade attention across weeks. An operator splitting into many identities hits a jade ceiling: total verified attention-hours per operator are capped by observed continuity, not headcount. Duplicates that dip below a crystal threshold of daily engaged minutes get throttled to nadir priority, losing market access.
